## Shopifytrigger Workflow

**Purpose**: ### Add more fields to Mautic
By default, the first name, last name and email are pushed to Mautic. If you require more fields, add it in the `Create contact` node.

**Services needed**: shopifyTrigger, mautic, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: auto-deploy

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating

_Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows_
_Curated by ai-ops-architect on 2026-05-05_
